passages.note: Senate floor vote (3rd Reading) on SB 880, a single-subject assault-weapons bill; McGuire voted Aye.

passages.provision_quote: This bill would revise this definition of “assault weapon” to mean a semiautomatic centerfire rifle, or a semiautomatic pistol that does not have a fixed magazine but has any one of those specified attributes.
passages.note: Chaptered bill text shows the operative clause: expanding the assault-weapon ban's definition to close the fixed-magazine loophole, while leaving other firearms untouched.

rows.reasoning: McGuire voted Aye on SB 880's Senate floor passage, a single-subject bill whose operative text expands the definition of banned "assault weapon" semi-automatic rifles and pistols (closing the fixed-magazine loophole) while leaving other firearm types subject only to existing law. This matches rung 2, "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms," and excludes rung 1 (no general ownership ban) and rung 3 (no background-check provision).
